# What a user does and sees (compat/apps.rs): each case after its tap.
# events-context-menu
tap id:case-events-context-menu
expect Menu: none
listens id:menu onContextMenu
# The secondary button over the view, with Shift and Command held.
event id:menu onContextMenu position.x=5 position.y=7 modifiers.shift=true modifiers.platform=true
expect Menu: at 5,7 page 25,71 meta shift
# Over the view inside it, which does not listen: the view around it hears it.
event id:inner onContextMenu position.x=30 position.y=12 modifiers.alt=true modifiers.control=true
expect Menu: at 30,12 page 50,76 alt ctrl
covers [events] onContextMenu
# events-gestures
tap id:case-events-gestures
expect Pan: none
event id:drag onPanStart translationX=2 translationY=-3 velocityX=10 velocityY=0
expect Pan: start 2,-3 v 10,0
event id:drag onPanEnd translationX=40 translationY=5 velocityX=250.5 velocityY=-12
expect Pan: start 2,-3 v 10,0; end 40,5 v 250.5,-12
expect Cancelled: false
event id:pinch onPinchStart scale=1.1 velocity=0.5
expect Pinch: start 1.1 v 0.5
event id:pinch onPinchEnd scale=2 velocity=-0.25
expect Pinch: start 1.1 v 0.5; end 2 v -0.25
event id:rotation onRotationStart rotation=0.1 velocity=1
expect Rotation: start 0.1 v 1
event id:rotation onRotationEnd rotation=1.5 velocity=0
expect Rotation: start 0.1 v 1; end 1.5 v 0
covers [events] onPanStart
covers [events] onPanEnd
covers [events] onPinchStart
covers [events] onPinchEnd
covers [events] onRotationStart
covers [events] onRotationEnd
# events-input
tap id:case-events-input
expect Focus: none
event id:field onFocus
expect Focus: focused
type id:field Hi
expect Keys: H i
expect Text: Hi
expect Selection: 2-2
type id:field !
expect Keys: H i !
expect Text: Hi!
expect Selection: 3-3
key id:field Backspace
expect Keys: H i ! Backspace
event id:field onSelectionChange start=0 end=2
expect Selection: 0-2
# The caret moved: in the input and in the root view, where the input is
# at 0,64.
expect Caret: none
event id:field onCaretMove
expect Caret: bounds,pageBounds bounds page 0,64 0x0
# Return submits what was typed.
expect Submitted: nothing
event id:field onSubmit text=Hi!
expect Submitted: Hi!
event id:field onBlur
expect Focus: focused blurred
# A multiline input's text wraps onto more lines as it is typed.
expect Size: height,width numbers as tall
type id:notes The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
expect Size: height,width numbers taller
# The app changes what is typed; typing continues from its value.
type id:upper ab
expect Upper: AB
prop id:upper value AB
type id:upper c
expect Upper: ABC
# A masked input, a read-only one, and the colors of placeholders and
# selections.
prop id:secret masked true
noprop id:field masked
prop id:fixed readonly true
noprop id:field readonly
style id:secret placeholderColor #888888ff
style id:secret selectionColor #ff6600ff
style id:pick selectionColor #00aa00ff
# The selection the app sets.
prop id:secret selectedRange start=0 end=2
covers [nsh] Input
covers [props] multiline
covers [props] masked
covers [props] readonly
covers [styles] placeholderColor
covers [styles] selectionColor
covers [events] onFocus
covers [events] onBlur
covers [events] onKeyPress
covers [events] onChange
covers [events] onSubmit
covers [events] onSelectionChange
covers [events] onCaretMove
# What the user pasted, reported; the input inserts nothing itself.
prop id:paste pasteBehavior report
expect Pasted: none
event id:paste onPaste text=hello
expect Pasted: hello files 0 uris 0
covers [events] onPaste
covers [props] pasteBehavior
covers [events] onContentSizeChange
covers [props] selectedRange
# events-layout
tap id:case-events-layout
expect Layout: 12,8 100x30
frame id:box 12 8 100 30
tap id:widen
expect Layout: 12,8 200x30
expect Lines: reported, an array
covers [events] onLayout
covers [events] onTextLayout
# events-media
tap id:case-events-media
# The platform loads the image and reports it.
expect Image:
event id:image onLoadStart
expect Image: start
event id:image onProgress loaded=512 total=2048
expect Image: start | progress 512/2048
event id:image onLoad width=640 height=480
expect Image: start | progress 512/2048 | load 640x480
event id:image onLoadEnd
expect Image: start | progress 512/2048 | load 640x480 | end
event id:broken onError message="not found"
expect Broken: error not found
# The video loads, plays, buffers, ends and fails.
event id:video onLoadStart
expect Video: start
event id:video onLoad duration=12.5 width=1920 height=1080
expect Video: start | load 12.5s 1920x1080
event id:video onProgress currentTime=3.25 duration=12.5
expect Video: start | load 12.5s 1920x1080 | at 3.25/12.5
event id:video onBuffer isBuffering=true
event id:video onBuffer isBuffering=false
expect Video: start | load 12.5s 1920x1080 | at 3.25/12.5 | buffering true | buffering false
event id:video onEnd
event id:video onError message="decode failed"
expect Video: start | load 12.5s 1920x1080 | at 3.25/12.5 | buffering true | buffering false | end | error decode failed
# The web view starts loading, navigates, loads, gets a message and fails.
event id:web onLoadStart url=https://example.com/ title="" loading=true canGoBack=false canGoForward=false
expect Web: start https://example.com/ "" loading true back false forward false
event id:web onNavigationStateChange url=https://example.com/a title="Page A" loading=false canGoBack=true canGoForward=false
event id:web onLoad url=https://example.com/a title="Page A" loading=false canGoBack=true canGoForward=false
event id:web onMessage data="hello there"
event id:web onError message="offline"
expect Web: start https://example.com/ "" loading true back false forward false | nav https://example.com/a "Page A" loading false back true forward false | load https://example.com/a "Page A" loading false back true forward false | message hello there | error offline
covers [nsh/image] Image
covers [nsh/video] Video
covers [nsh/webview] WebView
covers [events] onLoadStart
covers [events] onProgress
covers [events] onLoad
covers [events] onLoadEnd
covers [events] onError
covers [events] onBuffer
covers [events] onEnd
covers [events] onMessage
covers [events] onNavigationStateChange
# events-pointer
tap id:case-events-pointer
expect Press: none
# A finger goes down and comes up.
event id:press onPressDown
expect Press: in
event id:press onPressUp
expect Press: in out
# The mouse comes over, moves with Shift and Command held, and leaves.
listens id:hover onHoverIn
event id:hover onHoverIn
expect Hover: in
event id:hover onHoverMove position.x=5 position.y=7 modifiers.shift=true modifiers.platform=true
expect Hover: move 5,7 page 25,128 meta shift
event id:hover onHoverMove position.x=6 position.y=1 modifiers.alt=true modifiers.control=true
expect Hover: move 6,1 page 26,122 alt ctrl
event id:hover onHoverOut
expect Hover: move 6,1 page 26,122 alt ctrl out
# Files dragged over, away, back and dropped.
event id:drop onFileDragEnter
expect Drop: enter
event id:drop onFileDragLeave
expect Drop: enter leave
event id:drop onFileDrop uris=file:///tmp/a.txt uris="file:///tmp/b c.png"
expect Drop: dropped 2: file:///tmp/a.txt file:///tmp/b c.png
# An assistive technology performs an action.
event id:action onAccessibilityAction actionName=increment
expect Action: increment
event id:action onAccessibilityAction actionName=activate
expect Action: activate
covers [events] onPressDown
covers [events] onPressUp
covers [events] onHoverIn
covers [events] onHoverMove
covers [events] onHoverOut
covers [events] onFileDragEnter
covers [events] onFileDragLeave
covers [events] onFileDrop
covers [events] onAccessibilityAction
# events-scroll
tap id:case-events-scroll
expect Scroll: none
# A drag, then a fling that glides on and comes to rest.
event id:scroll onScrollDragStart x=0 y=0
expect Steps: begin 0,0
scroll id:scroll 0 120
expect Scroll: 0,120 content 300x1000 size 300x200 zoom 1
event id:scroll onScrollDragEnd x=0 y=120
expect Steps: begin 0,0 | end 0,120
event id:scroll onMomentumStart x=0 y=120
expect Steps: begin 0,0 | end 0,120 | glide 0,120
scroll id:scroll 0 300.5
expect Scroll: 0,300.5 content 300x1000 size 300x200 zoom 1
event id:scroll onMomentumEnd x=0 y=300.5
expect Steps: begin 0,0 | end 0,120 | glide 0,120 | stop 0,300.5
event id:scroll onScrollEnd x=0 y=300.5
expect Steps: begin 0,0 | end 0,120 | glide 0,120 | stop 0,300.5 | rest 0,300.5
covers [nsh] Scroll
covers [events] onScroll
covers [events] onScrollDragStart
covers [events] onScrollDragEnd
covers [events] onMomentumStart
covers [events] onMomentumEnd
covers [events] onScrollEnd
# events-touch
tap id:case-events-touch
expect A:
expect B:
expect C:
# A view takes the touches when they start and keeps them; its parent
# captures them first and is asked first.
touch start id:pad 5 6
expect A: capstart | start 5,6 page 15,80 1/1 #1 at 16 number | askcap 1 | ask 15,80 | grant | rstart 5
touch move 25 6
expect A: capstart | start 5,6 page 15,80 1/1 #1 at 16 number | askcap 1 | ask 15,80 | grant | rstart 5 | capmove | move 25,6 page 35,80 | askmovecap 20,0 | rmove 25
touch end 30 8
expect A: capstart | start 5,6 page 15,80 1/1 #1 at 16 number | askcap 1 | ask 15,80 | grant | rstart 5 | capmove | move 25,6 page 35,80 | askmovecap 20,0 | rmove 25 | capend | end 0/1 | rend 30 | release
# A responder that refuses to let go: the parent wanting the touches is
# rejected.
touch start id:keeper 4 4
expect B: keeper grant
touch move 34 4
expect B: keeper grant | want 30,0 | request | reject
touch end 34 4
expect B: keeper grant | want 30,0 | request | reject | keeper release
# A responder that lets go: the parent takes over, then the system cancels
# the touch.
touch start id:yielder 4 4
expect C: yielder grant
touch move 34 9
expect C: yielder grant | want 30,5 at 34,295 of 1 | request | yielder terminate | parent grant
touch cancel
expect C: yielder grant | want 30,5 at 34,295 of 1 | request | yielder terminate | parent grant | capcancel | cancel | parent terminate
covers [nsh] signal
covers [events] onTouchStart
covers [events] onTouchMove
covers [events] onTouchEnd
covers [events] onTouchCancel
covers [events] onTouchStartCapture
covers [events] onTouchMoveCapture
covers [events] onTouchEndCapture
covers [events] onTouchCancelCapture
covers [events] onStartShouldSetResponder
covers [events] onStartShouldSetResponderCapture
covers [events] onMoveShouldSetResponder
covers [events] onMoveShouldSetResponderCapture
covers [events] onResponderGrant
covers [events] onResponderReject
covers [events] onResponderStart
covers [events] onResponderMove
covers [events] onResponderEnd
covers [events] onResponderRelease
covers [events] onResponderTerminate
covers [events] onResponderTerminationRequest
# An input method's composition: started, changed, the committed text
# through onChange, then its end.
tap id:case-events-composition
listens id:compose onCompositionChange
event id:compose onCompositionChange composing=true text=t
expect Composition: composing [t]
event id:compose onCompositionChange composing=true text=teng
expect Composition: composing [teng]
event id:compose onChange text=腾
expect Committed: 腾
event id:compose onCompositionChange composing=false text=""
expect Composition: ended []
covers [events] onCompositionChange

# Mouse motion uses view-local coordinates, including negative positions.
tap id:case-events-pointer
listens id:hover onMouseMove
event id:hover onMouseMove x=5.5 y=7.25
expect Mouse: 5.5,7.25
event id:hover onMouseMove x=-2 y=0
expect Mouse: -2,0
covers [events] onMouseMove
